en.t: The first winter after the war arrived.

units.source_text: 一个星期五的晚上，开始下雪，直到星期六还下个不停。

en.t: One Friday evening, it began to snow, and it kept falling until Saturday.

units.source_text: 我在学校，中午放学回家，观赏雪中的金阁，这是最愉快的。

en.t: I was at school, and when classes ended at noon I went home; looking at the Golden Pavilion in the snow was the greatest pleasure of all.
